description: Nulls the sensor's +0.265V pedestal at the INA828 REF pin
notes: Buffered by a half of U-OPA-PITCH - REF needs a low source impedance or it degrades CMRR one-for-one. RANGE 0 TO +1.0V, not the 0-0.6V first specified. The pedestal is a SPEC BAND, 0.152-0.378V, not the 0.200V typical: nulling the top of it needs 0.826V at REF, and a 0.6V ceiling covers only 0.275V of pedestal. A part at the top of its own spec would have been un-nullable, leaving 1.4-5.6% of span standing at the jack - the same band as the polarity showstopper this trimmer replaced. +1.0V covers 0.458V with margin. FROM THE LM317'S 5.21V, NOT VREFOUT. VREFOUT is the DAC's internal reference, which is DISABLED at power-on until firmware writes an enable - so deriving the breath zero from it would make the analog breath path depend on a DAC register, which three documents correctly say it does not. The LM317 rail is up whenever +12V is. THIS IS WHAT MAKES THE PANEL KNOBS INDEPENDENT: with REF grounded the pedestal sits upstream of the gain pot and gets multiplied. description: Instrumentation amp - breath receiver, senses against AGND
notes: BREATH drives IN-, AGND drives IN+, REF is driven by TRIM-BREATH-ZERO through a BUFFER - never a bare divider, since source impedance on an in-amp REF pin degrades CMRR one-for-one. *** THE NUMBER IS 5 OHMS: *** SBOS792A, now in the repo at datasheets/analog/INA828IDR.pdf, section 8.1 verbatim - 'For the best performance, keep the source impedance to the REF terminal, RREF, below 5 ohm' - because RREF sits in series with one of the internal 40k difference-amp resistors and unbalances the bridge. The buffer was already right; it now has a spec to be right against. Output is 0V at rest to -9.6V at full (Vout = -2.185*(V_BREATH - V_AGND) + V_REF, with TRIM-BREATH-ZERO nulling the sensor pedestal). This field read "-0.44V at rest to -10V at full" until 2026-09-21 - that is the UN-NULLED output from before REF carried a trimmer, and trimming to it at E10 leaves the downstream stage ~1.8V off zero at the working gain; the downstream stage inverts, which is also the topology that does gain-then-offset with two pots in one op-amp half. The DAC ch6 zero injection that originally justified the input swap is deleted (ADR 0003). EMI: the part HAS an integrated RFI filter, -3dB at 53MHz, and EMIRR is a TABULATED characteristic not just a curve. WORST CASES ARE 48dB DIFFERENTIAL AT 400MHz AND 51dB COMMON-MODE AT 1.8GHz - note the differential and common-mode columns INVERT between 900MHz (52/98) and 1.8GHz (94/51), so any RF-rectification argument must use those two and not the 90-plus dB numbers. TI does not claim the internal filter is sufficient on its own. See hardware/module/breath-receive-stage/breath-receive-stage.md
G = 1 + 50k/42.2k = 2.185. Effective 2.161 after the bias/series divider -> 9.94V jack span. The panel gain knob absorbs the 0.6%
